open_points.subject: M28 Installation / K-16 service instance selection
open_points.text: K-16: "An installation selects one manifest instance per service"; M28: "service_instances: at most one selected instance per service ... a service with none selected is not invocable".
open_points.question: Must every service have exactly one selected instance, or can some services have none selected?
options: Exactly one selected instance for every service in the manifest
Zero or one selected instance per service; services with none are simply not invocable
open_points.default_guess: Zero or one per service, because M28 states non-invocable services with none selected.

open_points.subject: M28 Installation reload semantics
open_points.text: "the configuration is read at start; the token list is read again whenever it has changed"
open_points.question: When non-token installation fields change (for example manifest_revision, service_instances, service_credentials), does the running kernel pick up changes without restart?
options: No; only startup read applies (except token list hot-reload)
Yes; all installation fields are reloaded on change
Some fields reload and others require restart
open_points.default_guess: Only token list reloads live; other fields require restart.

open_points.subject: OperationBinding creation actions (propose/accept) vs unselected service instance
open_points.text: Primary action "propose an operation binding ... failure: manifest mismatch refused" and M28 "a service with none selected is not invocable".
open_points.question: If a service has no selected instance, are proposing and accepting a binding for its operation allowed, or refused?
options: Allowed; binding can exist, but invocation later refuses
Propose allowed but accept refused until an instance is selected
open_points.default_guess: Allowed to propose/accept; invocation refuses until an instance is selected.
